# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches and security updates for the current major release branch.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this project, please report it responsibly:

- **Preferred**: Use [GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/saihgupr/frigate-temp-mask/security/advisories/new) directly through this repository.
- Please do **not** open a public issue or forum discussion for sensitive vulnerabilities.
- Provide a detailed description of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

We will acknowledge receipt of your report, investigate the issue, and provide an advisory and fix as promptly as possible.
